items.title: Workday (WDAY): Buy, Sell, or Hold Post Q2 Earnings?
items.summary: What a time it’s been for Workday. In the past six months alone, the company’s stock price has increased by a massive 40.1%, reaching $192.03 per share. This was partly due to its solid quarterly results, and the run-up might have investors contemplating their next move.
